purpose: Candidate long-range function threads built from explicit literal source-language attestations. Terms establish first-pass membership only; they do not establish theological equivalence, causation, or actor identity.

threads.label: Source / House / Dwelling
threads.scope: Language of source, house, home, rooms, and dwelling as a recurring structural function.

threads.label: Threshold / Door / Gate
threads.scope: Language of thresholds, doors, gates, portals, and drains as passage/access functions.

threads.label: Ascent / Ladder / Axis
threads.scope: Explicit language of ladders, axes, throne/ascent structures, and north-of-north formulations.

threads.label: Growth / Seed / Root / Tree / Garden
threads.scope: Explicit growth vocabulary linking seed, root, tree, fruit, garden, gardener, planting, and growth.

threads.label: Death / Return
threads.scope: Explicit language of death, crucifixion/cross, tomb, resurrection, and return.

threads.label: Repair / Participation
threads.scope: Explicit language of fixing, repairing, building, healing, bridging, relations, togetherness, friendship, and participation.
